title: Sexual Assault
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents after sexual assault. Management: trauma-informed, multidisciplinary approach. Medical stabilization first, then forensic examination with consent. SANE examination if available. Forensic evidence collection (rape kit) within 72h. Document injuries. Labs: STI testing (CT, GC, HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B/C), toxicology if concern for drug-facilitated assault. Empiric STI prophylaxis: ceftriaxone + doxycycline + metronidazole. HIV PEP if exposure within 72h (28-day course). Hepatitis B vaccine if not immune. Mental health crisis counseling. Report to law enforcement (with patient consent). Safe discharge planning. Follow-up: STI re-testing, counseling.
